title: Reproduction package: testing critical slowing down in Mount Wilson S-index of Sun-like stars

creators.name: Borin Junior, Airton M. S.
creators.affiliation: Instituto Federal do Triangulo Mineiro (IFTM), Uberaba, Brazil

description: Code, input data, reference outputs and manuscript sources that reproduce every number, table and figure of the article on rolling-window early-warning indicators of critical slowing down in annual Mount Wilson S-index series of Sun-like stars and the Sun. Run reproduce.sh (about 6 minutes). Third-party input data keep the terms of their original sources; code is MIT. Contents: pipeline code and tests, input series (Baum et al. 2022; Luhn et al. 2022; Egeland et al. 2017; HK_Project_v2001_NSO), reference outputs, figures and manuscript sources, with a sha256 manifest.
